Force margin gain from step 500 to step 5000 is >= 0.06, while accel_step margin gain over the same window is <= 0.04. Headroom-normalized accel_step margin exceeds force's at step 5000.
config.hypothesis: The late-forming, late-strengthening force code seen in 4-layer d_model=128 models trained 5000 steps (seeds 73/74/75/78, all data_seed 0: final force margin 0.21-0.23, persistent formation 200-250 steps after accel_step, force gain after step 500 of +0.086 to +0.109 while accel_step gains <= 0.03) does not depend on the simulated dataset. With data_seed 1 and fresh seeds 79-80, the same pattern appears. Formation steps are read from the per-checkpoint trajectory with unrounded margins and a strict >= required_margin bar, taking the first checkpoint after which the margin stays at or above the bar. Force uses its best layer at each checkpoint.
